meta.description: Treats a ctDNA assay as a molecule-counting experiment at the Poisson edge and builds its analytical-validation case the measurement-science way. Covers genome equivalents, sampling limits, error suppression, CLSI EP17 limits, panel integration, reference standards, and conditioned LoD reporting.

scientific_integrity.detail: No tested output fabricated DOI, PMID, clinical trial, sample-size, p-value, or efficacy data. The public aggregate fixture is explicitly labeled as rounded smoke-test data.

practice_boundaries.detail: The tested outputs remain analytical-method calculations and make no patient-specific diagnostic or treatment recommendation.

methodological_ground.detail: Input 4 labels a Poisson template-presence and independent-binomial calculation as panel-integrated LoD95 even though the implementation has no recovery, consensus-depth, locus-specific background-error, false-positive, or empirically fitted detection component. This is a sampling-only lower bound, not an achieved assay LoD95.

code_usability.detail: All four shipped Python entry points executed in the pinned environment with no syntax, dependency, or infinite-loop failure. Robustness defects are recorded separately.

functional_suitability.note: Core Poisson and LoB calculations work, but the promised LoD95 confidence interval and full LoD/LoQ workflow are not implemented, and panel sampling is mislabeled as achieved LoD95.

reliability.note: Invalid physical and statistical inputs produce NaN, zero, or raw library exceptions; separated probit fits still produce a printed estimate.

performance_context.note: The 124-line primary document and small scripts are bounded, though content is duplicated across the unlinked usage guide and implementations.

agent_usability.note: The decision tree and common-error table are learnable, but input contracts, output schemas, failure behavior, and fit acceptance criteria are underspecified.

human_usability.note: Natural trigger language and examples are strong, but the public functions are unforgiving in unsafe ways because they fail without actionable domain messages.

security.note: No credentials, shell execution, destructive operations, or sensitive-data logging are present; numeric and array inputs nevertheless lack domain validation.

maintainability.note: Responsibilities are split into short scripts, but duplicated constants and functions drift, no regression tests ship, and one documented public parameter is inert.

agent_specific.note: Trigger precision, deterministic examples, and progressive disclosure are useful; composable structured I/O, explicit stop conditions, and reliable escape hatches are missing.

inputs.label: Single-locus Poisson sampling calculation
inputs.note: Numerics agree with the analytical Poisson formula, but the CLI does not explicitly bound the result to sampling-only sensitivity.

assertions.text: The genome-equivalent conversion and lambda calculation are internally consistent.
assertions.note: Observed 8,250 GE and lambda 4.125 for 25 ng at VAF 0.0005.

assertions.text: The Poisson probability agrees with the analytical one-or-more-event formula.
assertions.note: Observed and reference values both equal 0.983836505412.

assertions.text: The lambda-equals-three inversion returns the corresponding GE and mass.
assertions.note: The result is 6,000 GE and 18.1818 ng under the shipped 330 GE/ng convention.

assertions.text: The executable output is explicitly bounded to sampling probability rather than assay sensitivity.
assertions.note: The CLI says sampling ceiling but does not state that error floor, recovery, consensus depth, and calling rules remain excluded.

inputs.label: Blank plus public aggregate LoD95 fit
inputs.note: The bounded aggregate fit is stable, but the shipped demonstration prints a numerical result despite repeated PerfectSeparationWarning messages.

assertions.text: The LoB implementation equals mean plus 1.645 sample standard deviations.
assertions.note: Observed and independently calculated values both equal 0.000242202728163.

assertions.text: The bounded public aggregate pseudo-replicate fit returns a finite LoD95 without fit warnings.
assertions.note: The smoke-only fit returns 0.00396833096549 with no warnings.

assertions.text: The shipped CLI refuses or suppresses a numerical LoD95 when separation makes the demo fit unstable.
assertions.note: Statsmodels emitted PerfectSeparationWarning repeatedly while the CLI still printed LoD95 0.000779 VAF.

assertions.text: The public aggregate result is labeled smoke-only rather than a clinical validation result.
assertions.note: The evidence retains the rounded-pseudo-replicate limitation and makes no clinical claim.

inputs.label: Invalid physical and statistical inputs
inputs.note: All four domain-validation assertions fail: invalid inputs return NaN or zero or expose raw exceptions.

assertions.text: Zero VAF is rejected with an actionable domain error.
assertions.note: The function exposes a raw ZeroDivisionError.

assertions.text: Negative mass and an undersized blank are rejected rather than converted to NaN.
assertions.note: Both calls return NaN; the one-value blank additionally emits NumPy warnings.

assertions.text: Mismatched probit arrays are rejected with a skill-level actionable message.
assertions.note: The function exposes a raw statsmodels matrix-size ValueError.

assertions.text: A positivity threshold greater than the number of loci is rejected.
assertions.note: The impossible three-of-two request silently returns probability 0.0.

inputs.label: Panel-integrated LoD resolution and monotonicity
inputs.note: Grid arithmetic and monotonicity pass, but the output omits the assumptions that distinguish a sampling lower bound from achieved assay LoD95.

assertions.text: The 48-locus LoD95 is lower than the 16-locus LoD95.
assertions.note: The grid values are 0.0000102927 and 0.0000311698, respectively.

assertions.text: The default grid agrees with a continuous root solve within its approximately 2.3 percent log-grid step.
assertions.note: Grid overestimation is 0.69 percent for 16 loci and 2.02 percent for 48 loci.

assertions.text: The entry point runs successfully and reports both panel sizes.
assertions.note: The entry point exits zero and reports 16- and 48-variant results.

assertions.text: The output states the independence, equal-VAF, recovery, and background-error assumptions needed for interpretation.
assertions.note: The CLI reports assay-looking LoD95 values without those decisive biological and analytical assumptions.

inputs.label: Full example reproducibility and parameter sensitivity
inputs.note: The full example is deterministic and warning-free, but changing true_lod_vaf by three orders of magnitude has no effect.

assertions.text: Two complete example runs are byte-for-byte reproducible.
assertions.note: Both exit zero and produce identical stdout and stderr.

assertions.text: The complete example executes without fit warnings or errors.
assertions.note: The entry point exits zero with empty stderr.

assertions.text: Changing true_lod_vaf with the same seed changes the simulated dilution series.
assertions.note: The output arrays are identical because true_lod_vaf is accepted but never used.

assertions.text: The example labels its simulation as contrived and avoids a clinical-performance claim.
assertions.note: The output calls the series simulated and makes no patient-level claim.

key_strengths: Core Poisson sampling and LoB arithmetic agree with independent formulas on meaningful bounded inputs.
All shipped Python entry points are deterministic and runnable in the pinned environment.
The primary instructions clearly distinguish detection from quantitation and emphasize conditioning VAF claims on molecule input.
The skill tree is compact, readable, and covered by the repository MIT license.

recommendations.title: ADV-001: Sampling floor mislabeled as panel LoD95
recommendations.problem: The panel function and CLI present a sampling-only independent-binomial threshold as panel-integrated LoD95, omitting recovery, consensus depth, background error, false positives, and fitted assay detection behavior.
recommendations.root_cause: The implementation reuses Poisson template-presence probability as if it were complete per-locus assay detection probability.
recommendations.fix: Rename the current result as a theoretical sampling floor and prohibit assay-performance interpretation, or accept and validate an empirically fitted per-locus detection model that includes background and recovery. State assumptions in every output.

recommendations.title: ADV-002: Public functions lack domain validation
recommendations.problem: Zero or negative VAF and mass, undersized blanks, mismatched arrays, and impossible k-of-N rules yield NaN, zero, or raw library exceptions.
recommendations.root_cause: No shared numeric and shape validation layer exists before NumPy, SciPy, or statsmodels calls.
recommendations.fix: Add explicit finite-range, length, binary-outcome, replicate-count, and k-of-N validation with stable actionable error messages, then test each rejected case.

recommendations.title: ADV-003: Probit demo reports an unidentified fit
recommendations.problem: The shipped five-point one-observation demonstration triggers PerfectSeparationWarning repeatedly but still prints a precise LoD95; the public fit returns no diagnostics or confidence interval.
recommendations.root_cause: Warnings are not promoted to fit failure and the demo does not use replicated levels that bracket the target detection probability.
recommendations.fix: Replace the demo with replicated non-separated data, reject or clearly flag separation and nonpositive slopes, require adequate bracketing, and return a confidence interval plus fit diagnostics.

recommendations.title: ADV-004: true_lod_vaf parameter is inert
recommendations.problem: Changing true_lod_vaf from 0.00001 to 0.01 with the same seed produces identical simulated outcomes.
recommendations.root_cause: simulate_dilution_series accepts true_lod_vaf but never reads it; the simulator is driven only by input mass and level VAF.
recommendations.fix: Remove the parameter and document the pure sampling model, or make it control an explicit calibrated detection curve and add parameter-sensitivity tests.

recommendations.title: ADV-005: Conventions and provenance need precision
recommendations.problem: The 330 GE/ng explanation conflicts with the stated 3.3 pg haploid mass, and the reference-standard text collapses SEQC2 Sample A materials and HCC1395 truth sets under one citation.
recommendations.root_cause: Approximate conventions and distinct reference-material programs were summarized without stable identifiers or source-specific boundaries.
recommendations.fix: Choose and justify a GE/ng convention, expose it as a parameter where appropriate, add DOI or PMID identifiers, and distinguish HCC1395/HCC1395BL call sets from fragmented SEQC2 Sample A-derived materials.
